# PageTemplateElements

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The elements an element-based template chooses among; see [`pageTemplate`](page-template.md).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`default`](#default): Used on every page no more specific member covers.
- [`even`](#even): Used on even pages (2, 4, 6, …).
- [`firstPage`](#firstpage): Used on page 1 only.
- [`odd`](#odd): Used on odd pages (1, 3, 5, …) that `firstPage` does not cover.

### `default`

```typescript

```

*optional*

Used on every page no more specific member covers.
